description: Read a team gift by its code (from the invite link, like acme-4f2k): the company, the pick deadline, the delivery promise, and the designs a developer may pick, with each design's colours and the sizes available per colour. A team gift is free to the developer, so there are no prices. Read-only: it picks nothing. Use it before team_pick.

code.description: the team code from the invite link, e.g. acme-4f2k

name: get_team
